mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as elevated rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points from the previous month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which are associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy that is suppressing economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (as indicated by high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle expansions is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 thousand units signals a cooling housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as it reflects broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 112.0 (current level 112.6889) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to immediate market reactions to economic data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 112.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% and a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 377000 million dollars signals a dual shock to labor and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5 and RSAFS < 377000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 207.0), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as it dampens economic growth.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 207.0 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 207.0 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is above -0.03.
